summary: Rill (Devon Price) is a nonbinary anthro kingfisher, born 1962-04-05, with harbor weather observer as their work situation. Wry and observant, they brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

personal.residence: a quiet flat above a corner shop
personal.sleep_hours: Usually sleeps from 3 a.m. to 11 a.m., with a generally nocturnal routine.

fursona.accessories: A canvas satchel and a small brass pin
fursona.description:
Rill is an anthro kingfisher with a compact and sturdy presence. Their appearance features turquoise crown and orange breast; their eyes are hazel. They are easy to recognize by orange breast. The character has a quiet flat above a corner shop feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Rill keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. They work as harbor weather observer, though the job is only one part of their life. They enjoy spending quiet hours with kayak repair and watercolor.

personality: Rill is wry and observant. They tend to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. They appreciate clear communication and respect other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, they can be generous with their time and have a wry sense of humor. They have flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Rubs a thumb over a small keepsake when thinking.
• Night routine: They plan errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: They listen closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at their own pace.
• Work instinct: Their experience can help them spot a relevant detail, but they are not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: They welcomes respectful curiosity about their species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Rill enjoys kayak repair and watercolor. They have familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. They likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Rill while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds they in the middle of their day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about kayak repair turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to their work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: They could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use they/them pronouns for Rill. Their gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of their personality. They are an anthro kingfisher; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Rill's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that they be unavailable in daytime scenes. They can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
